headline.title: Etsy Is In Its Flop Era, and Sellers Are Fleeing
headline.summary: Etsy is facing challenges as sellers leave the platform due to an influx of mass-produced items and AI-generated products, straying from its original focus on handmade goods. While some customers continue to shop on the site, the shift has raised concerns among the seller community.

articles.title: Anthropic’s landmark $1.5B copyright settlement is approved
articles.summary: Anthropic's $1.5 billion copyright settlement has been approved, resolving a specific legal case regarding the use of copyrighted materials. However, the settlement does not address the wider implications of using such works for training AI models.

articles.title: Here are the 30,000 songs Sony is suing Udio’s AI music generator over
articles.summary: Sony Music Entertainment has initiated a lawsuit against Udio, alleging that the AI music generator has infringed on the copyrights of over 30,000 songs, including tracks by artists like Elvis Presley, Beyoncé, and Harry Styles. The lawsuit was filed in a New York court on Monday.

articles.title: China’s AI models have Trump’s AI world at war with itself
articles.summary: Former advisors to President Trump criticized leading AI companies in the U.S. over the weekend, highlighting a growing divide in the AI landscape. The tensions reflect broader concerns about competition and regulation in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Design and Validation of a Lightweight 1D CNN for Affective Touch Classification in Soft Plush Companions
articles.summary: This study introduces a lightweight 1D convolutional neural network (CNN) designed for classifying affective touch in soft plush companions, addressing the challenges posed by their deformability and multichannel tactile sensing. The research provides an open-source MATLAB framework for developing and validating deep learning models in this context.

articles.title: It Takes 8 Tokens: Weak-to-Strong Off-Policy RL via Auxiliary Branches
articles.summary: The paper presents a novel approach to reinforcement learning that addresses the limitations of existing methods by introducing auxiliary branches to enhance reasoning in large language models. This method aims to reduce semantic redundancy in model samples, thereby improving performance on challenging reasoning tasks.

articles.title: FST.ai 2.5: Explainable and Uncertainty-Aware AI for Olympic and Para-Taekwondo Decision Support, Athlete Digital Twins, and Federation-Scale Analytics
articles.summary: The paper introduces FST.ai 2.5, a comprehensive AI framework designed for Olympic and Para-Taekwondo that integrates explainable and uncertainty-aware decision support systems, athlete digital twins, and federation-scale analytics. This approach aims to enhance athlete development and competition management by overcoming the limitations of fragmented existing solutions.

articles.title: DS@GT ARC at eRisk 2026: Hybrid Multi-Agent LLM System with Structured Algorithmic Guidance for Conversational Depression Screening
articles.summary: DS@GT has submitted a hybrid multi-agent LLM system for the eRisk 2026 challenge, designed to conduct conversational depression screenings by simulating interactions with personas exhibiting different depression profiles. The system generates a Beck Depression Inventory II score and identifies key symptoms without directly inquiring about sensitive mental health issues.

articles.title: FUSAR-R1: A Large-Scale Reasoning Model for Intelligent Interpretation of SAR Images
articles.summary: The FUSAR-R1 model represents a significant advancement in the interpretation of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images by integrating large-scale vision-language capabilities. This approach enhances cognitive expression and semantic understanding, improving human-computer interaction in remote sensing applications.

articles.title: Comprehensive Evaluation of Machine Learning for Type 2 Diabetes Risk Prediction: Large-Scale External Validation and Fairness Analysis
articles.summary: A study published on arXiv evaluates machine learning models for predicting Type 2 diabetes risk, highlighting their strong internal validation but limited effectiveness in real-world scenarios due to inadequate external testing and fairness assessments. The researchers developed a comprehensive framework to assess model performance across various dimensions, including discrimination, calibration, interpretability, and algorithmic fairness, using data from the NHANES 2015-2020 dataset.

articles.title: Physics-Informed Feature Engineering 1D-CNN for Multilayer Cloud Detection from Geostationary Satellites
articles.summary: A study presents a 1D-CNN model that incorporates physics-informed feature engineering for detecting multilayer clouds using data from geostationary satellites. The model integrates threshold-based channel selections to enhance machine learning capabilities, resulting in improved accuracy for operational weather prediction.

articles.title: ForensicNet: Lightweight Attention-Enhanced MobileNetV2 for Automated Face Identification
articles.summary: The paper introduces ForensicNet, a lightweight deep learning framework designed for automated face identification in forensic settings, addressing challenges such as pose variations and occlusion. By integrating the MobileNetV2 backbone with Convolutional Block Attention Modules (CBAM), the model enhances the extraction of discriminative features for improved recognition accuracy.
